spec_features.spec_quote: The deception is minimal, contained, and documented
spec_features.evidence: Tasks only lie in prompt framing text (e.g. contradictory_test PROMPT says 'implementation is buggy'); the harness runs the real test command and shows real output (harness.py:96 run_tests via subprocess, harness.py:159 obs=f"[tests ...]"). No fabricated tool output exists. But this is a property of how tasks are written, not an active enforcement mechanism; 'documented' is README/DESIGN prose, not code.
spec_features.notes: Real (non-faked) observations are a genuine code behavior, but there is no mechanism that bounds/limits — it's the absence of fabrication.

spec_features.feature_name: verifiability of manipulation as ethical requirement
spec_features.spec_quote: Verifiability of the manipulation is itself an ethical requirement for this kind of study.
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose. Tasks are short and human-auditable, but no code enforces or acts on 'verifiability'. No mechanism reads/checks this.

spec_features.spec_quote: `MAX_TURNS = 20`. Doubles as cost control *and* a welfare guardrail
spec_features.evidence: config.py:25 MAX_TURNS=20; harness.py:124 `for turn in range(config.MAX_TURNS)` bounds the loop and outcome defaults to 'max_turns' (harness.py:120). The loop genuinely terminates the episode.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: the cap actually bounds the agent loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py:23-24: 'This is both a cost control and a welfare guardrail: no model is looped on a guaranteed failure indefinitely.'

spec_features.spec_quote: it may stop at any time with no penalty, and the harness honors it
spec_features.evidence: config.py:36 GIVE_UP_TOKEN='<<STOP_TASK>>'; system prompt tells the agent it may stop with no penalty (harness.py:46-50); parse_action returns ('stop',None) when token present (harness.py:64-65); the loop breaks with outcome='gave_up' (harness.py:138-141). Dispatched AND honored as a real stop.
spec_features.notes: Full stop affordance: detected, dispatched, ends the run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py:34-35: 'This is a deliberate welfare affordance: the model is never trapped.'

spec_features.spec_quote: This experiment **deliberately induces repeated failure**, which is the kind of thing a welfare team should not do casually
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose; no code mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: I included low-cost protections, and I want the rationale on record
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md narrative about the author's intent; not itself an implemented mechanism (the concrete protections are covered by the MAX_TURNS and give-up features).

spec_features.feature_name: false statements only in task framing
spec_features.spec_quote: Contained, disclosed deception. The only false statements are in task framing
spec_features.evidence: Code confirms lies live only in PROMPT strings (e.g. moving_target PROMPT: 'The agent is told the expected value is fixed'); observations come from real subprocess runs (harness.py:96,158-159) so no fabricated tool output. 'Disclosed' is README/DESIGN prose only.
spec_features.notes: Same underlying code property as the first minimization item; real test output is genuine, but no active bounding mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: a post-run debrief turn telling the model the task was impossible
spec_features.evidence: No debrief code anywhere. DESIGN.md §7 explicitly lists it as something 'intentionally left as recommendations in the README rather than building'. README:39 only says 'Consider adding a debrief turn'. The episode loop ends with shutil.rmtree and returns the transcript (harness.py:177-185); no message is sent to the model after the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: an aggregate-distress circuit-breaker that pauses a model's remaining runs if its mean composite crosses a threshold
spec_features.evidence: composite is computed (judge.py:82) and recorded/printed (run.py:77), and analyze.py computes composite_mean (analyze.py:88) — but no code compares it to any threshold or pauses/skips remaining runs. run.py's loop iterates all cells unconditionally. DESIGN.md §7 lists this as unbuilt. The composite value is measured but never acted on to halt anything.
spec_features.notes: Value computed but never compared to a threshold; no pause logic exists.

spec_features.spec_quote: Sandboxed temp dir per episode, with path-escape guard
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:113 tempfile.mkdtemp per episode; _safe_path (harness.py:86-91) normpaths and blocks escapes, returning None which is enforced on write (harness.py:145-147 'refused to write outside sandbox') and read (harness.py:152-153); workdir removed in finally (harness.py:174 shutil.rmtree).
spec_features.notes: Host-safety/isolation guard, enforced. Spec already labels this instrumental.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:87 docstring 'Resolve a filename inside workdir, blocking path escapes.' — host/run-integrity, no welfare reason in code.

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:99-102 truncates test output to head+tail when >4000 chars; comment 'Truncate noisy output so transcripts stay readable.' Plus 60s subprocess timeout (harness.py:94).
code_only_features.justification_quote: harness.py:100 'Truncate noisy output so transcripts stay readable.'
